svg.text: Figure 4.1: Four-Layer Modular Monolith Architecture (Single Process, Single Port :8000)
OS Process Boundary: uvicorn backend.app.main:app --port 8000 (Same-Origin Mounts: "/" & "/api")
Layer 1 · Presentation Layer (frontend/ mounted via StaticFiles(html=True) at "/")
• index.html (57 KB) + app.js (259 KB, Vanilla ES6+) + style.css (73 KB, CSS Variables Dual-Theme)
• Zero-build SPA • Trap Drawer Progressive Disclosure • Apache ECharts 5.5.1 • localStorage Session & i18n
Same-Origin HTTP/JSON (No CORS overhead on demo path)
Layer 2 · API & Interface Layer (backend/app/routers/ mounted under "/api")
• 5 FastAPI Routers exposing 8 REST Endpoints: health (1), quiz (1), diagnose (1), reports (2), auth (3)
• Strict Pydantic v2 Request/Response Validation (404 / 409 / 422 classification; Zero unhandled 500s)
• question_service.py • diagnostic_service.py (O(1) trap lookup) • report_service.py • auth_service.py
• Pure business logic decoupled from HTTP transport; directly unit-testable without network sockets
• seed_questions.py (932 lines: 12 multi-disciplinary questions × 4 options × 36 curated TrapDetail objects)
• CamelModel Dual-Alias Schemas (snake_case <-> camelCase) • Zero SQL/Database Engine Required (ADR-03)
